translated_title: Experts Rule Out ‘Fracking’ in Mexico’s Tampico-Misantla; Water-Well Drilling to Assess Two Basins Will Begin
original_title: Expertos descartan “fracking” en Tampico-Misantla; iniciará perforación de pozos de agua para evaluar dos cuencas
author: Anahí Del Ángel
meta_description: A science panel urged banning unconventional gas in the Tampico-Misantla basin; two others stay under study only if deep saltwater, not fresh, is found.
